name: Steel the Body and Mind [Meditation]
body:
When you take a moment to commune with the world around you, you gain certain benefits.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13+, Meditation Master, character level 9th.

Benefit(s): For 24 hours after you meditate, you steel yourself against physical and spiritual disruption. You gain a +4 bonus on saves against charm, compulsion, and polymorph effects as well as gain the ability to bypass an amount of DR possessed by spirits equal to 1/2 your class level.
